image_description: A side-profile view of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on sandy ground in front of dry, greyish brush. The rabbit has speckled grey-brown fur, large dark eyes, and upright ears with dark tips. Its white fluffy tail is visible at the rear. The forelegs are tucked under the chest, and the hind legs are folded beneath the body.
